# lumos_tasks (Data Source)

Tasks DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "lumos_tasks" "my_tasks" {
  access_request_id = "...my_access_request_id..."
  assigned_group_ids = [
    "..."
  ]
  assigned_user_ids = [
    "..."
  ]
  category = "...my_category..."
  expand = [
    "..."
  ]
  order_by       = "...my_order_by..."
  page_size      = 100
  page_token     = "...my_page_token..."
  product_area   = "...my_product_area..."
  search         = "...my_search..."
  show_all_tasks = false
  status         = "...my_status..."
  type           = "...my_type..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `access_request_id` (String) Filter by access request ID.
- `assigned_group_ids` (List of String) Filter by assigned group IDs.
- `assigned_user_ids` (List of String) Filter by assigned user IDs.
- `category` (String) Filter by task category. Ignored when `type` is passed.
- `expand` (List of String) Fields to expand: actions, assignees.
- `order_by` (String) Sort spec: `created_at`, `type`, `app`, or `target_user`, optionally followed by ` desc` (e.g. `created_at desc`). Defaults to newest first.
- `page_size` (Number) Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 100 are clamped to 100 rather than rejected.
- `page_token` (String) Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `product_area` (String) Filter by product area.
- `search` (String) Search string.
- `show_all_tasks` (Boolean) Show all tasks in the domain (admin only).
- `status` (String) Filter by task status.
- `type` (String) Filter by task type.

### Read-Only

- `next_page_token` (String) Token for the next page, or null when this is the last page. An absent token is the only end-of-results signal. A page holding fewer than `page_size` items does not mean the results are exhausted. Treat the value as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.
- `tasks` (Attributes List) The tasks in this page of results. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tasks))
